title: Co-changing Tool Lists Across PyInstaller Specs and build.py
answers: What files must change if adding, renaming, or removing a mitmproxy CLI tool?
Where are PyInstaller specifications defined for mitmproxy binaries?
How do PyInstaller spec files configure tool-specific exclusions?
body:
The set of standalone CLI tools (`mitmproxy`, `mitmdump`, `mitmweb`) is explicitly mirrored across packaging scripts and spec files:
1. `release/build.py:standalone_binaries`: Iterates over `tools = ["mitmproxy", "mitmdump", "mitmweb"]` to invoke PyInstaller.
2. `release/specs/standalone.spec`: Loops over each tool and applies conditional exclusions (e.g., excludes `mitmproxy.tools.web` when not `mitmweb`, excludes `mitmproxy.tools.console` when not `mitmproxy`) and tool-specific options (e.g., unbuffered mode on `mitmdump`).
3. `release/specs/onedir.spec`: Also hardcodes `tools = ["mitmproxy", "mitmdump", "mitmweb"]` for directory-based distribution.
4. `pyproject.toml:[project.scripts]`: Maps each command name to its entry point function in `mitmproxy.tools.main`.
applies: Applies when adding, renaming, or modifying entry-point CLI tools or their binary packaging options.
says: The standalone desktop release bundle is missing one of the command line tools.
A newly added command line utility is not included in the downloadable installer.
Running the packaged binary for the web interface includes unnecessary console tool dependencies.
Ensure all packaged command line tools are built into the standalone release archive.
